messages:
Carla M: Heads up team, entering quiet corridor T-10m. Please hold any non-critical merges to main. We have a small but visible embedding regression after the recent quant rollout.
Ben C: How small? If it's tiny we could ride it out, but we need a mitigation plan for launch.
Carla M: ~3% of similarity queries shifted beyond acceptable threshold for two key customers. Not huge, but ranking drift is causing support tickets. Prefer an immediate temporary unpin to previous quant variant while we investigate.
Alice W: Can we do a soft rollback only for production traffic out of the EU region to limit blast radius?
SRE Oncall: We have spare capacity in dedicated pools in us-west and eu-west. Recommended: staged traffic swap: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% over ~3m steps with healthchecks.
Erin P: I'll own the rollout. Need approval to execute a pin to embed-quant-v2 and route traffic progressively. What are the health thresholds?
Ben C: p50 latency delta < 20ms and error_rate < 0.4%. If either crosses, abort and re-evaluate. Also capture sample inputs for offline repro.
Carla M: Approved. Also annotate release notes with the quiet-window revert and a link to the incident ticket after.
deploy-bot: Received: /deploy pin project=embeddings version=embed-quant-v2 reason="quiet-window revert"
deploy-bot: Staged pinning enabled. Plan: step1=5% step2=25% step3=75% step4=100%. Automated healthchecks attached.
SRE Oncall: Healthcheck definitions attached to the rollout: 
- p50_latency_ms < 140
- error_rate_pct < 0.5
- embed_similarity_stddev not to increase > 0.02
If any breach, rollback command will be triggered.
Erin P: Starting step1 -> 5%. Monitoring dashboards and tail logs.
Erin P: step1 ok, no anomalies. advancing to 25%.
Ben C: Remember to add a fallback auto-unpin script in case traffic causes downstream consumer errors.
Erin P: Noted. rollback commands (pinned here for quick copy):
```
# emergency rollback
/deploy pin project=embeddings version=embed-quant-v3 reason="auto-rollback"
/deploy route project=embeddings traffic=100% target=embed-quant-v3
```
Carla M: Good. Keep the postmortem ticket linked: https://ourtracker/RED-2201 and note customer ids affected.
deploy-bot: Step2 -> 25% complete. No health breaches detected.
Erin P: Moving to 75%. Watching tail latency and customer-side ranking telemetry.
SRE Oncall: Logs look clean. No increase in errors or retry storms.
Erin P: Step3 -> 75% success. Proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: Pin completed: project=embeddings version=embed-quant-v2. Traffic now 100%.
Ben C: :thumbsup: Good quick decision. Please add an item to the next retro to revisit quant tuning and add more preproduction similarity tests.
Alice W: Also add a note to the launch doc: "Temporary revert to embed-quant-v2 during quiet corridor to preserve customer ranking stability; investigation ongoing."
Carla M: I'll update the launch readiness checklist and mark the quiet corridor preserved. Thanks for the rapid response. Closing thread once changelog and release notes updated.
Erin P: Changelog updated and postmortem ticket created. Closing checks green. :white_check_mark:
